statement_summary: Security Officer and Privacy Officer designated in writing
Yearly risk analysis with SP 800-30; risks owned and treated
Risk acceptance authority; no acceptance of risks to dialysis runs or 911 redirects without treatment
HIPAA sanctions recorded; good-faith reporting protected
No BAA, no ePHI, including AI features; subcontractor BAAs checked yearly
Yearly independent evaluation
Six-year retention of security documentation
Yearly policy review; policies available in the shared drive and dispatch binder
Written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions
Named accounts only; shared dispatch account retired by 2026-10-31
Role-based least privilege with written approval; facility portal accounts limited to the facility's trips
MFA for every platform user and every administrator login, including MSP-held logins
Termination checklist completed by the last day or shift; idle per diem accounts disabled after 60 days
Monthly account reconciliation; quarterly role check; yearly facility portal confirmation
Weekly export log check; monthly access and sign-in review
2-minute mobile lock; 10-minute computer lock; documented equivalent for the dispatch desktop
Sealed emergency administrator credential
Named MSP and vendor accounts with MFA; no unmanaged remote access tools; yearly technician list
Password length; yearly Wi-Fi and alarm code change
Minimum necessary look-ups only
No patient information in personal accounts, personal phones, or public AI tools
Lock screens and tablets; dispatch screen out of view; never share passwords or MFA codes
Training at hire and yearly; phishing simulations; recording and AI intake training
Report suspected incidents and lost devices at once
Signed policy acknowledgment
Ransomware and dispatch outage runbook kept and printed
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Log every incident
Four-factor breach risk assessment; discovery date recorded
Meet notification deadlines in the P08 matrix
Manual dispatch at once; 911 redirect never waits for systems
Insurer hotline first; MSP engaged under BAA
Ransom payment only with approvals and an OFAC check
Business associate incident reports logged and handled
Yearly tabletop with the MSP and a manual dispatch drill
Lessons learned within 30 days
Three classification levels
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit, including email to facilities
Restricted data only in approved systems
Device and ePHI inventory, including vehicle hotspots
New tools and features approved and under BAA before receiving Restricted data
Approved AI tools only
90-day immutable backup versions; MFA on the console; quarterly restore test
Wipe or certified destruction with records
Retention schedule: 7 years for trip and PCS records; 2 years for recordings; 6 years for security records
Patient care report available to the receiving hospital; limited disclosures only
